## Context / Problem

Operator ruling (recorded in comments, 2026-08-22): option (b) approved. The 0707 dense-banking
eval (`tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py`) is re-scoped to SYSTEM-level
boundedness: the oracle counts durable banking events regardless of actor — genuine model
`record_criterion_verdict` upserts AND the policy's silent bounded-fallback insufficiency
snapshots — and asserts progress is durably banked at bounded evidence-response intervals. No
steering nudge is added to production; the model's voluntary banking cadence is explicitly no
longer the measured contract.

Why: commit e1352535ace (ticket dd41-239d-6e09-4a86) deliberately let batched governed evidence
reads execute and removed the COMMIT_STEERING_NOTICE pressure that had made the model interleave
genuine records. Post-merge run 32575679530 proved the system bound still holds (the policy's
per-criterion 3-response fallbacks fire on schedule, source="fallback", snapshots one response
low per the documented ordering caveat: 2/5/8), but the eval's observer counts only
source=="tool" writes, so the model's genuine first banks at responses [6,7,8,9,9] fail the
3-response bound 3/3 deterministically. The observer's actor filter is the last stale facet of
the pre-dd41 contract.

## Approach

Test-only change; no production code. In the shared seam `tests/_bank_observer.py`, re-scope
`make_observed_upsert`'s bookkeeping from `source == "tool"` to any durable run-time bank write
regardless of source, EXCLUDING cache seeds (`seeded=True` marks pre-run cache seeding, not run
progress). Keep the bounded-gap oracle (`bounded_bank_gaps`) unchanged — it already bounds
first-bank gaps in evidence responses. Update the module docstring, the eval's docstring, and
the oracle regression's docstring to name the ruled contract (system-level boundedness,
operator ruling on this ticket). Update the unit regressions:

- `tests/unit/test_completion_bank_observer_forwarding.py`: the first-write bookkeeping test now
  asserts a fallback-sourced write IS recorded and a seeded write is NOT.
- `tests/unit/test_completion_banking_oracle.py`: add a GREEN case proving a fallback-only
  transcript (model never records; the REAL policy fail-closes every criterion at its
  per-criterion 3-response boundary, observed snapshots [2,5,8,11,14]) passes the oracle; add a
  RED case proving the oracle in final form REJECTS a genuinely-unbounded system (fallback
  disabled via a no-op fallback_record, model banks only after 6 evidence responses →
  first gap > 3); add a replay of the live run-32575679530 shape (silent fallbacks + genuine
  records from response 6) proving it is GREEN under the ruled scope.

Validation limit: the live bedrock arm cannot run locally. Local validation is the stub replay
through the REAL `wrap_completion_evidence_policy` (the proven [2/5/8] fallback snapshot
schedule gives gaps within bound 3). Live confirmation lands on the next scheduled/dispatched
external-integration run.

## Scope

- tests/_bank_observer.py
- tests/external/test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py
- tests/unit/test_completion_banking_oracle.py
- tests/unit/test_completion_bank_observer_forwarding.py

## Testing

`python -m pytest tests/unit/test_completion_banking_oracle.py tests/unit/test_completion_bank_observer_forwarding.py -q`
in the worktree venv; external module collects cleanly. Strict test-modification order: the
revised oracle+observer are seen RED in final form against a genuinely-unbounded transcript
(no-op fallback, late model banks) before the change counts; mutation check re-runs the GREEN
fallback-only case with the gap bound dropped to confirm teeth.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `make_observed_upsert` records the first durable bank write of each criterion regardless
  of `source`, excluding `seeded=True` cache seeds, verified by the updated forwarding
  regression.
- [x] A fallback-only transcript through the REAL policy (snapshots [2,5,8,11,14]) PASSES the
  oracle, and the live run-32575679530 shape (fallbacks at 2/5 + genuine records from response
  6) PASSES, each asserted by a dedicated unit case.
- [x] A genuinely-unbounded transcript (fallback disabled, first durable bank after >3 evidence
  responses) FAILS the oracle, asserted by a dedicated unit case run in the final oracle form.
- [x] Docstrings in the shared seam, the eval, and the oracle regression name the ruled
  system-level contract and cite this ticket's operator ruling.
- [x] No files outside the four declared test paths change; `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and
  `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` pass in the worktree venv.
- [x] [non-codebase] The validation limit (live bedrock unavailable locally; next external-integration run is
  the live confirmation) is stated in a ticket comment at close.
